description: This file declares the GetAppInfo class, which inherits from Command, and is part of the rialto::servermanager namespace. It includes references to HttpRequest and TestService classes, and defines a constructor, destructor, and a run method. The file serves as a header declaration for a command that retrieves application information within the server manager component.

classes.name: GetAppInfo
classes.description: A command class that encapsulates the operation to get application info, holding references to a TestService and an HttpRequest, and providing a run method to execute the command.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command with a reference to a TestService and an HttpRequest.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the command to retrieve application information.
